responsibility: Implements the solver’s search-graph execution state, managing the active goal stack, cycle detection, provisional and global caching, solver-mode-dependent cache usage, reevaluation of cycle roots when provisional results change, and finalization of completed goals into globally cached query results.
same_name_distinction: Among the `solve/*/mod.rs` files, this one is specifically the execution-state manager for the new solver. It owns the active goal stack, provisional entries, cycle handling, overflow behavior, and promotion into the global evaluation cache, rather than canonicalizing query I/O like `canonical/mod.rs` or defining the top-level solver interface like `solve/mod.rs`.
